pending_actions.action: Unblock serpapi.com egress for scheduled runs. The remote execution environment's network policy rejects CONNECT to serpapi.com:443 with 403, so the Google reviews sync (and any other SerpAPI-dependent routine) cannot run there at all. Either allowlist serpapi.com in the environment's network policy or move this scheduled task to an environment with open egress. NOTE: this is DISTINCT from the existing 'Restore SerpAPI plan' item below — that one is quota exhaustion (HTTP 429 from SerpAPI); this one is the proxy refusing the connection before SerpAPI is ever reached (HTTP 403 on CONNECT). Fixing the billing will not fix this.
